lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: Huff... huff... Damn, you broke right through my strongest guard.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: That was an intense duel, Naruto. But this castle is finally within reach.

lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: Heh, fair enough. You truly proved yourself in combat.

lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: The inner sanctum lies just beyond these doors. Keep your guard up.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Thanks. I'll see this mission through to the very end.

lines.speaker: Naruto
lines.text: Don't you dare give up now! Charge ahead and claim your victory! Believe it!
